name: Mix and spatially shaped noise (cg-noisetools)
plain: Chain-style NOISE wrappers. Mix blends two noise sources linearly with a very small default weight, for near-seed variation. Shape multiplies amplitude across the image by a sine or triangle profile, so noise can be stronger at the center. Optional renormalise.
math:
Mix: m = ε1·(1−w)+ε2·w; with mask: m·mask + ε1·(1−mask).
Shape: profile(x)=2sin(πx/L)−1 or 1−|4x/L−2|; A(y,x)=(1+w·p(y))(1+w·p(x)); out=ε·A.

props.spectrum: as supplied, amplitude varies in space
